Bybit Hack Sparks Market Turmoil 

The $1.5B Bybit hack has shaken the crypto market, triggering price dips across major tokens:

🔻 Bitcoin (BTC): $96,332 (-2.19%)
🔻 Ethereum (ETH): $2,705 (-1.98%)
🔻 Solana (SOL): $172.07 (-3.39%)
🔻 Dogecoin (DOGE): $0.244 (-4.55%)

Bybit CEO

🚨The SEC has delayed its decision on multiple crypto ETFs, including Spot Solana ($SOL), Spot XRP, Spot Litecoin ($LTC), and Spot Dogecoin ($DOGE). New deadlines now push rulings to May 2025.
